events.title: Startup News launches (renamed Hacker News on August 14)
events.felt: Pre-instrumental. A link-voting site for startups, from the people who funded Reddit. Magnitude estimated from contemporary accounts. The August rename set the naming convention for most of this catalog: “Hacker” plus one noun.

events.title: Please tell us what features you'd like in news.ycombinator
events.felt: Two days after launch, the original site asks what features it should have. 1,590 replies. Most of this catalog is one of them, shipped.

events.title: News.YC open-sourced
events.felt: The fault's source code is released to the public. Seismologists still argue about whether this caused everything.

events.title: Nickb's very own New Mogul:  business, leadership, management and financial news.arc
events.felt: Hacker News, but for business, leadership and management, on the same Arc code. The earliest rupture of the But-For Fault in this catalog.

events.title: ICombinator - Hacker News for the iPhone
events.felt: Hacker News, but on an iPhone, sixteen months after the iPhone.

events.title: Ask HN: A site like Hacker News, but about art?
events.felt: First documented demand-side rupture: someone asks for Hacker News, but about art. Ruptures preceded by an Ask HN are classed as demand-side.

events.title: The earliest version of HN I can find; 166 LOC
events.felt: Core sample recovered: the earliest known Hacker News, 166 lines of Arc. This survey's index.html is longer.

events.title: Hacker News clone for Singapore
events.felt: Hacker News, but in Singapore time. The front page, delivered while San Francisco sleeps.

events.title: Hacker news, but for ideas
events.felt: Hacker News, but for ideas. Ideas, upvoted. Implementation left as an exercise.

events.title: Hacker News reader for iPhone (new native app)
events.felt: Hacker News, but native on the iPhone. Second rupture of the iPhone segment in thirteen months.

events.title: Hacker News for Education
events.felt: Hacker News, but for teachers. Graded on a curve.

events.title: HackerMed - My HN-like Site for Hackers Interested in Bio/Med
events.felt: For hackers interested in bio and med. Self-diagnosis, upvoted.

events.title: PG Got Twitter So I Made Hacker News For Tweets
events.felt: pg got Twitter, so someone made Hacker News, but for tweets.

events.title: A Comfy Helvetica frontpage for Hacker News
events.felt: Hacker News, but in Helvetica. The first recorded reskin. Verdana declined to comment.

events.title: Show HN: HN Trends - like Google Trends, but for Hacker News
events.felt: Google Trends, but for Hacker News. The same segment re-ruptured in June 2026, fifteen years later.

events.title: Show HN: Like Button for Hacker News
events.felt: A Like button, but for Hacker News. Hacker News already had one. It was called the upvote.

events.title: An HN style social news site written in Ruby/Sinatra/Redis/JQuery by Antirez
events.felt: An HN-style site, written by the author of Redis, on Redis.

events.title: Hackful - A Hacker News for Europe
events.felt: Hacker News, but for Europe. Same site; the comments arrive nine hours earlier.

events.title: Hacker News clone for Python
events.felt: Hacker News, but for Python. The indentation in the comments was finally consistent.

events.title: Lobsters
events.felt: Hacker News, but invite-only, with tags. One of the few aftershocks that became a fault line of its own.

events.title: Designer News
events.felt: Hacker News, but for designers. Ran for over a decade; a 2024 post declared it dead.

events.title: HipsterNews - DesignerNews theme for HackerNews
events.felt: Hacker News, but styled like Designer News, which is Hacker News, but for designers. Early fault interference.

events.title: Hacker News For Africa
events.felt: Hacker News, but for African tech. Fewer posts about parking in Palo Alto.

events.title: Show HN: Most mentioned movies on HN
events.felt: The movies HN mentions most. The earliest rupture of the Mentioned-On Fault in this catalog. Thirteen years later this fault would produce an M 7.9.

events.title: A Hacker News For Ideas
events.felt: Hacker News, but for ideas, again (see 2009). The ideas remain unshipped.

events.title: Show HN: I made an HN for the financial industry
events.felt: Hacker News, but for finance. Not financial advice.

events.title: Show HN: Coinspotting - A Hacker News For Bitcoins and Other Cryptocurrencies
events.felt: Hacker News, but for Bitcoin. Three days after the one for bankers; the bankers were not consulted.

events.title: Hacker news for data scientists
events.felt: Hacker News, but for data scientists. Completes the December 2013 swarm: three But-For ruptures in nine days.

events.title: Show HN: Product Hunt – Hacker News for Products
events.felt: Hacker News, but for products. It became a company, and the survivorship bias for every entry below it.

events.title: We Built a Hacker News for Biotech
events.felt: Hacker News, but for biotech. “It’s just X with extra steps,” but the steps are CRISPR.

events.title: A Hacker News for grad students?
events.felt: Demand-side rupture. Graduate students request a more efficient place to procrastinate.

events.title: Show HN: Hacker News Redesign
events.felt: A redesign of Hacker News. Hacker News was not redesigned.

events.title: Show HN: I made a Hacker News for podcasts
events.felt: Hacker News, but for podcasts. Top comment, every time: “Is there a transcript?”

events.title: Show HN: Top books mentioned in comments on Hacker News
events.felt: The books mentioned most in HN comments. The first of many book lists in this catalog. The books have not changed.

events.title: Show HN: Hacker News for cryptocurrency and Blockchain
events.felt: Hacker News, but for crypto. Second rupture of the segment Coinspotting broke in 2013; recurrence interval 3.7 years.

events.title: Hacker News for Hackers
events.felt: An essay titled “Hacker News for Hackers.” The earliest self-referential rupture in this catalog, nine years ahead of schedule.

events.title: Hacker News equivalent for other fields
events.felt: Demand-side rupture. The fields remain underserved; the question does not.

events.title: Ask HN: What's the Hacker News for different industries?
events.felt: A survey of the fault zone, conducted by the fault zone. Every reply named a smaller fault.

events.title: Show HN: Hacker Daily, a daily podcast for Hacker News readers
events.felt: Hacker News, read aloud as a daily podcast. The comments were wisely left out.

events.title: Show HN: HN.Academy – Top online courses recommended by Hacker News users
events.felt: The online courses HN recommends. Completion rates were not published, for everyone’s sake.

events.title: Show HN: Hacker News front page in the style of a print newspaper
events.felt: Hacker News as a printed front page. The first edition with no comment section, and the first one people finished.

events.title: Show HN: I made a Hacker News for the automotive industry
events.felt: Hacker News, but for the automotive industry. Same front page, more torque.

events.title: Hacker News in the Style of Teletext
events.felt: Hacker News, but on Teletext. Still loads faster than most of the links.

events.title: Show HN: Hacker XP – Hacker News styled as a Windows XP Outlook email client
events.felt: Hacker News as a Windows XP Outlook inbox. Every story arrives unread. Inbox zero remains theoretical.

events.title: Hacker News stylized as a retro 90s macOS desktop
events.felt: Hacker News as a 1990s Mac desktop. Nobody asked for an Electron version.

events.title: Show HN: I made Hacker News but for research papers
events.felt: Hacker News, but for research papers. Comments now open with “I only read the abstract, but.”

events.title: Show HN: Play the front page of Hacker News as interactive text games
events.felt: Every front-page story as an interactive text adventure. You are in a maze of twisty little comment threads, all alike.

events.title: Extracting Hacker News book recommendations with the ChatGPT API
events.felt: HN book recommendations, extracted with the ChatGPT API. The first LLM recorded on this fault. Afterwards, ruptures got cheaper.

events.title: "Hacker News" for retro computing and gaming
events.felt: Hacker News, but for retro computing and gaming. Also known as Hacker News.

events.title: The Hacker News Top books of 2023
events.felt: The year’s most-mentioned books. A seasonal tremor; recurs each January.

events.title: Show HN: I built a LLM-powered Ask HN: like Perplexity, but for HN comments
events.felt: Perplexity, but for HN comments. Answers now cite a 2013 thread with total confidence.

events.title: Show HN: HackerNews but for research papers
events.felt: Hacker News, but for research papers, fifteen months after the last one. Seismologists call this a doublet.

events.title: Show HN: I mapped HN's favorite books with GPT-4o
events.felt: HN’s favorite books, mapped with GPT-4o. Cartography for a shelf nobody finished.

events.title: Show HN: Meet.hn – Meet the Hacker News community in your city
events.felt: Hacker News, but in person, in your city. The first rupture that required pants.

events.title: Show HN: Hacker News frontpage as a print newspaper that you can personalize
events.felt: Hacker News, but as a personalized print newspaper. Second newsprint rupture (see 2020).

events.title: Hacker News for Gamedev
events.felt: Hacker News, but for gamedev. Every engine debate, now with a dedicated venue.

events.title: Show HN: I built an interactive HN Simulator
events.felt: Hacker News, but every post and comment is generated. The uncanny part is how little had to change.

events.title: Show HN: Books mentioned on Hacker News in 2025
events.felt: Every book mentioned on HN in 2025. Ten months before the mainshock, the fault was already loaded.

events.title: Hacker Tube – Timeless tech videos (popular on Hacker News)
events.felt: Prior art: “Hacker Tube – timeless tech videos popular on Hacker News,” nearly five months early. Same name, same idea. Magnitude is not a property of the rock alone.

events.title: Hacker News but for independent blogs
events.felt: Hacker News, but for independent blogs. Also known as Hacker News, circa 2009.

events.title: Show HN: I made Google Trends for Hacker News by indexing 18 years of comments
events.felt: Google Trends, but for Hacker News, from 18 years of comments. Re-rupture of the 2011 HN Trends segment.

events.title: Show HN: Hacker News but as Tweets
events.felt: Hacker News as tweets, which is where half the links pointed anyway.

events.title: Show HN: HackerBa – Hacker News with a Baidu Tieba UI
events.felt: Hacker News in a Baidu Tieba UI. Confirms the fault crosses the Pacific.

events.title: Ask HN: Is there any Hacker News but for investing/trading/economics etc.?
events.felt: Demand-side rupture: is there a Hacker News, but for investing? Answered in 2013 (see Bored Banker). The fault has no memory.

events.title: Show HN: HN.watch – Videos of all Hacker News posts
events.felt: Videos of every Hacker News post. A foreshock, five weeks early. Foreshocks are identified only in hindsight.

events.title: Tools Hacker News keeps asking for
events.felt: The tools HN keeps asking for, mined from HN, fourteen hours before the mainshock. Nobody noticed. Nobody ever does.

events.title: HackerTube: YouTube built from videos recommended by HN
events.felt: YouTube, built from 6,454 videos recommended in about 40,000 HN comments since 2007. It shipped an export of its data for your agent “to easily create your own version,” which lowered the activation energy of every aftershock below to roughly one prompt.

events.title: Show HN: HackerNewsTV – Daily YouTube playlist of latest HN videos
events.felt: A daily YouTube playlist of the latest HN videos. The first aftershock, three and a half hours in.

events.title: Show HN: HackerBooks – HackerTube, but for books mentioned on HN
events.felt: The largest aftershock so far, twenty hours in, and the sixth book list in this catalog.

events.title: Show HN: Hacker News – HackerBooks, but for all the posts on HN
events.felt: “HackerBooks, but for all the posts on HN.” Links to news.ycombinator.com. The rupture propagated back to its own epicenter, under two hours after HackerBooks.

events.title: HackerShorts(cinelet) – the short films HN keeps telling people to watch
events.felt: The short films HN keeps telling people to watch. Runtime is no longer an excuse.

events.title: HackerTok: TikTok but for Hacker News
events.felt: TikTok, but for Hacker News. The first of three in this sequence.

events.title: Show HN: 13M opinions on 48k products extracted from Reddit and HN
events.felt: 13M opinions on 48k products, extracted from Reddit and HN. The domain name is doing the peer review.

events.title: Show HN: Wikihack – HackerTube, but for Wikipedia articles mentioned on HN
events.felt: Wikipedia articles mentioned on HN: an index of everything we read instead of working.

events.title: Show HN: HackerHack – HackerBooks but for Posts Posted on HN
events.felt: “HackerBooks, but for posts posted on HN.” Links to news.ycombinator.com. The second independent discovery, thirteen hours after the first, that Hacker News is Hacker News for Hacker News.

events.title: Show HN: HackerPapers – 3,314 arXiv papers and the HN conversations behind them
events.felt: The arXiv segment ruptures for the third time (see 2023 and 2024).

events.title: Show HN: HNMovies – 2,280 films and docs distilled from 20 years of HN
events.felt: Re-rupture of the 2013 movies segment. Recurrence interval: 13.5 years.

events.title: Show HN: HackerBlogs – the 9,434 blogs HN people keep sharing
events.felt: See also bubbles.town, June: the same blogs, ranked twice in one year.

events.title: Show HN: XButForY - Showcase your X but for Y websites
events.felt: A showcase of “X, but for Y” websites. This survey’s closest living relative. We have not been in touch.

events.title: Show HN: Individual podcast episodes as recommended by HN
events.felt: The 2016 podcast segment ruptures again. Transcripts still requested.

events.title: Querying HackerTube, HackerBooks and Wikihack Directly with DuckDB/Hugging Face
events.felt: Querying HackerTube, HackerBooks and Wikihack directly with DuckDB. The first seismologist arrives on the scene.

events.title: Show HN: HackerTube for Apple TV. Videos HN Recommends, on Your TV
events.felt: HackerTube, but on your TV. The aftershocks reach the living room.

events.title: Hacker Mentions –> HackerTube for X Mention
events.felt: HackerTube, but for mentions on X. Posted as a tweet; the aftershock has left the fault zone.

events.title: Show HN: Hacker News but for comments posted on HN
events.felt: “Hacker News, but for comments posted on HN.” Links to /newcomments. The third rediscovery of Hacker News on Hacker News in under nineteen hours.

events.title: Ask HN: Isn't anyone worried about this flood of HackerTube-but-for apps?
events.felt: “Isn’t anyone worried about this flood of HackerTube-but-for apps?” The first official felt report.

events.title: Show HN: HakTok – TikTok for Hacker News
events.felt: TikTok for Hacker News, the second. Swipe up for the comments, which are longer than the video.

events.title: HackTok: Infinitely Scrollable HackerTube
events.felt: Infinitely scrollable HackerTube, 88 minutes after HakTok. The TikTok segment is now a triplet.

events.title: HackerHype: HackerTube, but for Hacker* Aggregators
events.felt: HackerTube, but for Hacker* aggregators. The fault ruptures into itself: recursion depth 2.

events.title: Show HN: Hacker News Aggregators, Aggregated
events.felt: Hacker News aggregators, aggregated. Recursion depth 2, ten minutes after the other recursion depth 2.

events.title: Show HN: HackerZon – HackerTube but for Amazon products mentioned on HN
events.felt: Amazon products mentioned on HN. We assume the cart is mostly keyboards.

events.title: Show HN: HackerWords – HackerTube, but for words used on HN
events.felt: Words used on HN. The fault has reached the dictionary.

events.title: Show HN: HackerGames –  HackerTube, but for Games mentioned on HN
events.felt: Games mentioned on HN. Factorio has been notified.

events.title: Show HN: Hnrepos.com, HackerTube for Repositories
events.felt: Repositories HN links to: GitHub stars, with comment threads attached.

events.title: Show HN: HN Atlas – Discover tools to better engage with Hacker News
events.felt: A directory of tools for engaging with Hacker News. A map of the damage, drawn from inside it.

events.title: Show HN: HackerProducts – HackerTube, but for products mentioned on HN
events.felt: Five and a half hours after HackerZon. The product segment is now a doublet.

events.title: Show HN: Hacker News, à la Lobsters
events.felt: Hacker News, styled like Lobsters, which is Hacker News, but invite-only (2012). The faults have begun to interfere.

events.title: Show HN: HN Books – the books Hacker News keeps recommending
events.felt: The second book list of this sequence, 32 hours after HackerBooks.

events.title: Show HN: HackerTV – HN's most-recommended YT videos as 24/7 TV channels
events.felt: HN’s most-recommended videos as 24/7 channels. HackerTube, but for not choosing.

events.title: Show HN: Hacker Times, a New York Times-inspired version of Hacker News
events.felt: Hacker News as The New York Times. All the news that’s fit to upvote.

events.title: Own Your HackerTube,an AI Curator Inspired by Karpathy's HackerTube
events.felt: HackerTube, but for you. The sequence rediscovers personalization, the thing HackerTube was built to escape.

events.title: Show HN: Theirshelf - HackerBooks, but for books mentioned by influential people
events.felt: Books mentioned by influential people. The sequence has spread beyond HN.

events.title: Show HN: Hacker GitHub – the GitHub repos HN links to most
events.felt: The second repository rupture in ten hours (see hnrepos).

events.title: Show HN: HackerCinema, a portal for all the Movies/TV mentioned on Hacker News
events.felt: Movies and TV mentioned on HN, 27 hours after HNMovies. The film segment has become a doublet, and nobody has started watching.
